response.sql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_amount, transaction_count, CAST(total_amount AS REAL) / SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM account_totals ORDER BY fraction_of_total DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;
